dashboard.about: The main dashboard provides an instant overview of the organization's financial performance, logistics health, and inventory status.
how_to_use: Monitor charts to track the balance between Revenue and Expenses.
Review Inventory Alerts (in red) to identify out-of-stock products immediately.
Track recent business activities and financial logs in the bottom tables.
dashboard.access: System Administrators (Admin) and staff with view permissions for metrics.

employees.about: Use this page to manage the workforce, assign employees to specific branches, and update their personal and financial records.
how_to_use: Click 'Add Employee' to open the new staff registration form.
Select a 'Warehouse/Branch' to link the employee to a specific physical location.
Use action icons to edit records or view the comprehensive 360-degree profile.
employees.access: HR Managers and Branch Managers (filtered by their location).

orders.about: This page is used to manage customer sales orders from initial creation to preparation for shipping.
how_to_use: Click 'New Order' to open the sales order creation interface.
Select the customer and product items, then save the order.
Track order status (Pending, Shipped, Cancelled) directly from the main table.

invoices.about: Manage financial invoices issued to customers and track payment and collection status.
how_to_use: The page displays a list of all issued invoices and their values.
Print invoices or send them to customers using the action icons.
Invoice status updates automatically when payments are recorded in Accounting.
invoices.access: Sales Managers, Accountants, and Finance Officers.

customers.about: A comprehensive database of the organization's customers, allowing for tracking of their records and contact details.
how_to_use: Use the search bar to find specific customers quickly.
Click 'Add Customer' to register a new client profile.
View a customer's purchase history by clicking the profile icon.

purchase_orders.about: Request goods from suppliers and track their arrival at warehouses to ensure stock availability.
how_to_use: Click 'New Purchase Order' and select the supplier and required products.
Specify the 'Warehouse' where the goods will be received.
Once items physically arrive, confirm receipt to update stock levels.

purchase_requests.about: This page is for employees to internally request materials or goods. These requests are reviewed and approved by management before being converted into official purchase orders.
how_to_use: Click 'Create Request' and describe your needs in the 'Justification' field.
Select the products and quantities required accurately.
Save the request as a draft first, then click the 'Submit' icon to send it for approval.
Once approved, the procurement department will process your requisition.
purchase_requests.access: All employees authorized to request work materials.

suppliers.about: Manage supplier data and entities that provide raw materials or products to the organization.
how_to_use: Register supplier details, addresses, and contact numbers.
Link suppliers to product categories for easier sourcing.
Track supplier performance and historical supply records.

inventory_dashboard.about: This dashboard provides a graphical analysis of inventory health, total stock value, and shortage ratios across all branches.
how_to_use: Review charts to identify fast-moving vs. slow-moving products.
Monitor total stock value to assist in procurement budgeting.
Analyze damage statistics to implement better handling procedures.

products.about: Manage the product catalog (goods or services), set pricing strategies, and generate barcodes for each item.
how_to_use: Click 'New Product' to enter item details and barcode information.
Update pricing or product images using the action icons in the table.
Use category filters to manage specific groups of products efficiently.
products.access: Warehouse Managers, Procurement staff, and Sales teams.

inventory.about: Monitor real-time physical stock levels across all warehouses and track the movement of goods.
how_to_use: Use filters to view stock for specific products or locations.
The page displays Available, Reserved, and Net stock quantities.
Export these reports for periodic physical inventory counts.

warehouses.about: Define the organization's physical branches and warehouses, and assign responsible staff to manage location-based access.
how_to_use: Create new warehouses and define their physical addresses.
Link employees and managers to specific locations to ensure data isolation.
Enable or disable warehouses based on operational needs.

inventory_damage.about: Record and categorize items that have been damaged or broken to exclude them from sellable stock.
how_to_use: Submit a damage request with reasons and supporting photos if available.
Stock is only deducted after the request is reviewed and approved.
Track damage history to analyze and reduce shrinkage costs.
inventory_damage.access: Warehouse staff (to report) and Inventory Managers (to approve).

stock_adjustment.about: Used to manually adjust stock quantities (increase or decrease) to match physical inventory counts.
how_to_use: Select the product and warehouse, then enter the new quantity or adjustment value.
You must provide a clear reason for the adjustment (e.g., annual count variance).
All adjustments are logged in the audit trail for transparency.
stock_adjustment.access: Authorized staff with elevated inventory permissions.

internal_transfer.about: Manage the movement of goods between organization branches, tracking shipments from dispatch to receipt.
how_to_use: Create a transfer request by selecting source and destination warehouses.
Mark the shipment as 'Shipped'. The destination must then confirm 'Received'.
Stock levels update at the destination only after formal receipt confirmation.

attendance.about: A screen for recording and monitoring daily employee attendance and tracking late arrivals or overtime hours.
how_to_use: Record employee check-ins by selecting the time, date, and attendance status.
Names appear based on their assigned branch/warehouse for which you have authorization.
You can review and edit previous attendance logs in case of registration errors.
attendance.access: Branch Managers, HR Officers, and System Administrators.

payroll.about: Manage financial operations related to employee salaries, including tax calculations, insurance, and bonuses.
how_to_use: Select the month and year, then click 'Generate Payroll' to automatically pull data.
Review each employee's salary details (Base, Deductions, Net) before final approval.
You can print the Payslip for each employee after the final calculation.
payroll.access: Accountants, HR Managers, and Finance Officers.

hr_dashboard.about: An analytical dashboard displaying workforce statistics, recruitment rates, and graphical distributions of employees by branch.
how_to_use: Monitor real-time attendance and absence rates.
Track payroll cost trends through historical charts.
Review status of pending leave requests and active recruitment pipelines.

recruitment.about: Manage the recruitment lifecycle, from advertising vacancies to final candidate selection.
how_to_use: Add new job vacancies and define exact requirements.
Track applicants through recruitment stages (Interview, Assessment, Offer).
Convert a selected candidate into an 'Employee' in the system with a single click.

time_off.about: A system for submitting and tracking leave and absence requests, with automatic balance calculations.
how_to_use: Employees can submit leave requests (Annual, Sick, Emergency).
Direct Managers or HR department review and approve/reject requests.
The page updates the employee's leave balance automatically upon approval.
time_off.access: All Employees (to apply) and Managers (to approve).

appraisals.about: Manage annual or periodic performance appraisals to link achievements with incentives and promotions.
how_to_use: Define key objectives (KPIs) for each employee at start of the period.
Conduct periodic reviews and record notes and performance scores.
Results are used for employee development plans and bonus calculations.

general_ledger.about: The central record of all financial transactions within the organization, documented in detailed accounting entries.
how_to_use: Use filters to search for specific entries by date or account type.
Review debit and credit movements to ensure account balancing.
Export account statements for external auditing or internal review.

chart_of_accounts.about: A structured list of all accounts used in the system, organized by international accounting categories.
how_to_use: Add sub-accounts under main categories like Assets, Liabilities, etc.
Ensure the correct 'Account Type' is selected for proper financial report generation.
Deactivate accounts that are no longer in use to keep data clean.

expenses.about: A screen for recording all operational expenses and petty cash purchases to ensure accurate cost tracking.
how_to_use: Record new expenses by selecting category (Rent, Salary, Maintenance) and amount.
Upload receipt photos as attachments for legal and financial documentation.
Monitor spending status and VAT classification where applicable.

profit_loss.about: A strategic report showing the company's financial performance and net profit or loss over an accounting period.
how_to_use: Define the time frame (Monthly, Quarterly, Annually).
The report compares total revenue against total expenses and purchases.
Use this data to evaluate the company's financial operational efficiency.
profit_loss.access: Finance Managers, Business Owners, and Executives.

trial_balance.about: A control tool used to verify accounting accuracy by ensuring debit and credit balances match before financial statement preparation.
how_to_use: Ensure total debits equal total credits; any variance indicates a ledger entry error.
Review all account balances at a single glance.
Used as a key step in the periodic financial closing process.

bi_spreadsheet.about: An advanced Business Intelligence tool that emulates Excel spreadsheets with smart features and direct database connectivity.
how_to_use: Design custom reporting sheets not available in standard static reports.
Use built-in financial formulas to analyze cash flows and projections.
Save and export these spreadsheets for management meetings and strategy planning.

documents.about: A central archive for storing and managing important files, invoices, and administrative documents with departmental categorization support.
how_to_use: Upload files and assign them to the relevant department (Finance, HR, etc.).
Search for files by name or filter them by category for quick access.
Download, rename, or delete files based on your assigned permissions.
documents.access: All administrative staff with document handling authorization.

annual_report.about: A comprehensive financial report summarizing the organization's performance throughout the year, featuring quarterly comparisons.
how_to_use: Review total revenue and expenses for the current fiscal year.
Analyze expense distribution by department to assist in future budgeting.
Use quarterly data to identify peak periods or financial contractions.
annual_report.access: Business Owners, Executives, and the CFO.

year_end_closing.about: This process permanently closes the current fiscal year, carries forward opening balances to the new year, and locks all accounting records for the period.
how_to_use: Ensure all journal entries and financial reports are finalized before closing.
Select the fiscal year to be closed from the dropdown menu.
Click 'Permanently Close Fiscal Year' to confirm and log the action.

audit_logs.about: A historical audit trail that documents all movements and sensitive operations within the system to ensure the highest levels of transparency and security.
how_to_use: Search for specific operations using the username or operation type (Add, Edit, Delete).
Review each operation's details to identify which fields were changed and their previous vs. new values.
Accurately monitor IP addresses and timestamps to track any suspicious or unauthorized activity.
audit_logs.access: System Admin, Financial Auditor, and Department Managers (based on permissions).
